title: Stefan Hogeborn's 2012 dive: dark black surface and near-freezing water

tellings.quote: >> No, Stiafon was one of the divers down there 2012 and he brushed off the sediment of it and it's dark black.

plain: In 2012 a diver named Stefan Hogeborn went down to an odd object on the floor of the Baltic Sea, brushed the sediment off it in near-freezing water, and found the surface underneath was dark black. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, whose team found the object and thinks it may be a UFO, tells this as what his diver saw. If true, it would be a first look at what the object is made of.
